purpose: The preview gateway's committed SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEYS entry versus the key the preview deployment serves at /.well-known/inherit-upload-jwks.json. Public keys only; the private half never leaves the owner's secret stores.

committed.derivedWith: node crypto.createPublicKey({ key, format: 'jwk' }).export({ format: 'jwk' }), kid kept from the private key

served.how: curl with x-vercel-protection-bypass and x-vercel-set-bypass-cookie, following the 307 that sets the cookie

note: kid, x, y, kty and crv are equal; the served document adds alg ES256 and use sig, which the committed shape omits on purpose (the gateway reads kid, x and y).
